segments.en:
We've entered the Earth Realm's
Brave Continent.

GGG ("Three G") in "Tokio"
is offering to cooperate.
Displaying the marker.

Changing course.
Heading for Tokio.

rows.notes: [jp] Tokio (sibling Sunrise Eiyuutan glossary spelling); [jp] -> GGG ("Three G") as in the library.

segments.en: GGG Command Center

Welcome to
GGG Headquarters.

I'm Taiga,
the commander.

I'm glad to be able to
fight alongside you!

The pleasure is ours. We look
forward to working with you.

Straight to business, Commander Taiga:
could you fill us in on the situation
on the Brave Continent?
Let's see...

Mikoto!
Would you explain?
Understood.

Several years ago, the Brave
Continent was invaded by
Gilgamesh and Deloyer.

And that war is still
going on today.

That's because each city on the
Brave Continent has organized its own
defense force and kept on resisting.

Now those defense forces work together;
they've grown into the Brave Alliance.

GGG is one organization within
the Brave Alliance, you see.

So basically, the people of the
continent, scattered at first,
are now working together.
Well, that's about the size of it.

But... all we've managed to protect
is a small area around each city.

The enemy has cut the cities off from
each other; the truth is we can't even
stay in proper contact.
Is that right...

Until now, holding the line
was the best we could manage.

But with your fleet joining us,
the situation has changed.

Because now we, too, can form a mobile
force and go on the counterattack.

In other words, your fleet
is the key to victory!

Oh, Guy!
Welcome back!
I'm back, Mikoto!
Good work out there.

Just a Deloyer recon unit.
We didn't even need to go out...

It's a stalemate, after all...
They can't afford to commit
their forces either.

But it never hurts
to be careful.

Oh, that's right!
Let me introduce you.

"Guy Shishioh," and
"Renais Cardiff Shishioh."

Both of them are GGG's
top agents.
Good to meet you!

Yeah,
good to meet you!
Now, back to the matter at hand.

As I said earlier, the enemy has
surrounded every city on the
Brave Continent.

Sweep these enemies away and join up
with each city's defense force.

If you can join up with them all, we
should in time drive every last enemy
off the Brave Continent.

Commander Taiga!
Let me go too!

Of course. That was
my intention.

Guy, Renais, I want you two to
represent GGG and form the core
of the force.

The Mechanoid units will devote
everything to defending Tokio.

You two go out there and
cut loose all you want!
That's what I was waiting to hear!

Right.
Let's get moving.

GGG's staff representatives have
joined the unit.

Machine added:
GaoFighGar x1

The following ships have joined the fleet:
Izanami
Tsukuyomi
Well, guess I'll set up the squads.
Hold it right there.

Oh, you're...
Renais, right?

The enemies surrounding the cities
include some strong infantry squads.

Mech Squads alone won't be enough
to take back the cities.
Yeah, I know.

rows.notes: Taiga's [jp] / [jp]: honorific dropped. Izanami (ship) not in the glossary. [50] Renais's [jp] rendered gruff ('Hold it right there.'). [51] [jp] -> 'Renais'. | [editorial 47] system line aligned to 'Machine added:\n<name>' (as rows 11/17 in this unit) | [proofread 53] capitalisation: the player's squad type is 'Mech Squad' (UI term; corpus majority)

segments.en: This is...!
What's wrong?!

A distress call!
Putting it through!!
It's an emergency!

GGG's Kyoto branch is
under enemy attack!!
So the enemy moved faster than we did...

They must have read our moves
and acted on it.

Maybe that recon unit from earlier
reported in.
This is Taiga at HQ!

Head for Kyoto
at once!
Roger!!
Set course for Kyoto!
Roger!
Displaying the marker!!

rows.notes: Swan's foreign accent ([jp] / [jp]) not reproduced in English. [jp] Kyoto (not in the glossary).

segments.en:
Made contact with the enemy
forces surrounding Kyoto.

You came for us!
Big Bro Guy!
Of course I did!

Come on, Mamoru!
Let's fight together!!
Yeah!!

rows.notes: [jp] -> 'Big Bro Guy' (cf. the Rie 'Big Bro' decision).

segments.en: Enemy fleet repelled.

Air superiority over Kyoto
secured.
This is the Kyoto branch!

Enemy infantry squads are still
all over the city!

Shall we send in our
Infantry Squads?

Attack now
Attack later
Sending in the Infantry Squads now.

We'll take the ground once
we've regrouped.

This ship will withdraw from
the front for now.

rows.notes: [proofread 4] capitalisation: own squad type 'Infantry Squad' (UI term; as in dlg_4822_10353_00 and dlg_4822_10363_01) | [proofread 6] capitalisation: own squad type 'Infantry Squad' (UI term)

segments.en: Commencing infantry combat.
Damn you...

Heh...
To think the Earthside had
a fighter this skilled.
We're pulling back!
Wait!!

Stop!
Chasing them too far is dangerous!
Let go of me!
Toya!

If we don't do it now,
then when?!
Now, hold on!

The enemy still has
strength to spare.

If we let them get away now, it'll be
the same thing all over again!

Quit acting like
a spoiled brat!

That fight just now...
You didn't win it
all on your own, did you!
Ngh...!

Tch!
Don't make so much trouble for us.

In any case, our first priority now
is to join up with our allies.
Let us go!
Let's go, Toya.

rows.notes: [1] [jp] 'the Earthside' (not in the glossary). [5] [jp]: Garriel is presumably holding Toya back. [4] Garriel -- speaker header; gender per speakers.tsv.

segments.en: Kyoto successfully liberated.
You can now dock at Kyoto.

Oh, Kanji.
A message from the captain.
Yeah, what is it?

More new forces are joining,
she says.

So she wants you to go pick them
up at the "GGG branch."

Roger!
I'll be off, then.

rows.notes: [jp] = Rie (captain of Kanji's ship), hence 'she'.

segments.en: GGG Kyoto Branch
I'm sorry, Mamoru...

Because I wasn't strong enough,
I made you go through this.

What are you talking about?
That's not like you,
Big Bro Guy!
I'm a GGG member too!

Let's keep working together
from now on!

Yeah, Mamoru...
You're right.
There you are, Kanji.
Sorry to keep you waiting!
Oh, Kanji!

Um, I'm
Mamoru Amami.
I'm GaoGaiGar's pilot!

I see. So you're the one
who's been piloting GaoGaiGar.

Yes.
I'm looking forward to working with you.

Yeah, same here!
Mamoru!

Joined up with the members
of GGG's Kyoto branch.

Machine added:
GaoGaiGar x1

rows.notes: [2] [jp] unspecified -- 'go through this' (presumably Mamoru piloting/fighting). [9] [jp] / [14] [jp]: honorifics dropped. | [editorial 6] 'You're right... It's just like you say' said the same thing twice | [editorial 12] 'who was moving GaoGaiGar' literal (accuracy flag)

segments.en:
Ah!
Please wait a moment.

Hm?
What is it?

In that fight earlier,
it was you who helped us,
wasn't it?

Oh, I guess you could
say that.

Right now, we're officially
a GGG detached unit.

From here on, we'll be
joining up with you guys.
Huh?

It should have been settled
with GGG already...

Oh, so that's it.
I'll show you to the ship.
We're in your hands!

The Animanoids, Toya, and Kira
have joined the unit.

rows.notes: [accuracy 3] Kira asks whether it was Kanji's group that helped them; [jp] is a hedged yes ('I guess that would be us'), not 'that's how it turned out' | [accuracy 4] [jp] = it has been arranged / they are formally counted as one; 'supposed to be' read as if they are not really one | [editorial 10] system line aligned; serial comma so Toya and Kira don't read as the Animanoids' names

segments.en: Enemy forces spotted!

They're surrounding
Nouvelle Tokio!
All hands, battle stations!!
We'll wipe out the enemy forces!
The battle will now begin.

rows.notes: [jp] Nouvelle Tokio (Might Gaine city; not in the glossary).

segments.en: The enemy forces have withdrawn.

You can now dock at
Nouvelle Tokio.
So this is Nouvelle Tokio...
It's a big city...

Yeah...
This is the city protected by
the Brave Express Team.

Could you go meet them
right away?

Sure.
So where should I go?

The Senpuuji residence.
I'll take you there now.

Come on, Guy,
you're coming too!
I'm going too?

I've still got patrol duty,
though.
I already told the commander.
Come on, let's go!
Whoa!
Mikoto sure looks happy.

It must have been a while since
the two of them went out together.

While each city was cut off, I bet
they never got... to do this.

Suggest a detour
Go straight to the Senpuuji home

Hey!
Since we're out anyway, why don't
we take a little detour?
I'm all for it!

Hey!
Kanji, not you too!
What are you saying?

Ha ha!
What's the harm?
You've got a little time, right?
Guy... please...
Oh, all right...
Yaaay!
Mikoto's Command level went up.
Guy's Warrior level went up.
Whoops!

If I space out, they'll
leave me behind!
Kanji's Command level went up.

rows.notes: [5] source [jp] read as [jp] (typo). [15] choice page. [jp]/[jp] -> Command/Warrior level (no UI string found for the stat names; unverified). | [accuracy 2] duplicated word: 'Team' appeared twice ('Brave Express Team / Team protects') | [editorial 2] line break left 'protects.' stranded; reordered | [editorial 19] [jp]: Kanji siding with Mikoto ('Now you're saying it too' implied she said it first; accuracy flag)

segments.en: The Senpuuji residence...

Long time no see,
Maito!
Guy!

Sorry for making you
come all the way out here.
Mikoto filled me in.

You'll be coming on behalf of
the Brave Express Team, right?
Yes!

We'll be representing the
whole Brave Continent.
I'm counting on you, Maito!

Protecting everyone's happiness
is the mission we've been given.

We'll see it through,
no matter what!
Joined up with Maito Senpuuji.

Machine added:
Might Gaine x1

rows.notes: [7] [jp] rendered 'here for the whole Brave Continent' (lit. 'representatives of the Brave Continent'). | [editorial 7] 'We're here for the whole Brave Continent' unclear; [jp] = representing

segments.en: Enemy forces spotted!

They're surrounding
Yosho Town!
All hands, battle stations!!
We'll wipe out the enemy forces!
The battle will now begin.

rows.notes: [jp] Yosho Town (library has Yosho Academy).

segments.en: The enemy forces have withdrawn.

You can now dock at
Yosho Town.
Big Bro!

Hm?
What is it, Rie?

New machines and staff
have arrived, so I'll leave
the rest to you!
Roger!
Oh, so this is the machine.

Raijin-Oh.
This town's guardian deity.
Huh...

Oh!
Looks like the one in charge is here.
Hello!

I'm Maria Shiratori,
the class representative.

Starting today, we'll be
in your care!
Huh?

You're Raijin-Oh's
pilot?

Oh, no, I'm not.
The pilots are...

I'm Jin!
Nice to meet ya, mister!

I'm Asuka.
Nice to meet you!

I-I'm Koji...
Pleased to meet you...

So, these three
are the pilots.

Uh, r-right...
I see...

The rest of the class and I control
Raijin-Oh from the operations
command room.

So the commander of the Earth Defense
Class is... you, the class rep...?
Yes, that's right.
We're counting on you!

The Earth Defense Class
has joined the unit.
Raijin-Oh has been deployed.

rows.notes: [14] Jin's [jp] to Kanji -> 'mister' (a kid addressing an older stranger). | [editorial 19] 'Me and the rest of the class' off-voice for the prim class rep

segments.en: Enemy forces spotted!

They're surrounding
Aozora Town!
All hands, battle stations!!
We'll wipe out the enemy forces!
The battle will now begin.

rows.notes: [jp] Aozora Town (library has Aozora Elementary School).

segments.en: The enemy forces have withdrawn.

You can now dock at
Aozora Town.
Big Bro!

Hm?
What?

New machines and staff
are here!
I'll leave the rest to you!
Roger.
So this is Gambaruger.

Heh heh,
pretty cool, huh?

Yeah, it looks
pretty tough.

...Wait, are you
by any chance...

Gambaruger's pilot,
Kotaro the Yellow Ganbar!

Same here,
I'm Yosuke, the Blue Ganbar.

I'm Rikiya, the Red Ganbar.
Pleased to meet you.
Yeah, good to meet you all.

The Ganbar Team has joined
the unit.
Gambaruger has been deployed.
Enemy forces spotted!
They're surrounding the city!
All hands, battle stations!!
We'll wipe out the enemy forces!
The battle will now begin.

Enemy fleet repelled!
Air superiority secured.
Message from the city!

Hey there!
The city's still under attack!
Do somethin' about it!

Looks like the enemy infantry
squads haven't pulled out yet...

Shall we send in our own
Infantry Squads?

Attack now
Attack later
Sending in the Infantry Squads now.

We'll take the ground once
we've regrouped.

This ship will withdraw from
the front for now.

rows.notes: [proofread 4] capitalisation: own squad type 'Infantry Squad' (UI term) | [proofread 6] capitalisation: own squad type 'Infantry Squad' (UI term)

segments.en: Commencing infantry combat.
Sankai City successfully liberated.
You can now dock at Sankai City.

rows.notes: [jp] Sankai City (library has Sankai High School).

segments.en:
Hey!
Kanji!

Oh, Guy.
What's up?

More new forces are joining
us from this city.

I need you to head to the
"Amano Lab" right away.

That's where you're set
to meet up with them.
The "Amano Lab," right?

Got it.
I'll be off.

rows.notes: [editorial 3] term: [jp] 'the Amano Lab' (project decision) | [editorial 5] term: [jp] 'the Amano Lab' (project decision)

segments.en: Amano Peace Science Laboratory

Huff... huff... phew...
So this is the lab...

Never thought a lab would be...
on top of a hill like this...

Oh!
Glad you made it.

Hm?
Did you walk all the way up?

I took a taxi as far as
the foot of the hill.

I'm military, so I figured it'd be
better if nobody noticed me
coming and going here...

How admirable, for a young
fella these days.
Still, that's a relief.

After all, we'll be in your care
aboard your ship from now on.
Thank you for your cooperation!

Now, now, don't be so stiff.
It doesn't suit you.

Ha ha ha!
Guess it doesn't.

Well then, let me introduce
the lab staff.

I'm Yutaro Katori,
Dr. Amano's assistant.

Ah, Yutaro,
there's no need to hide
anything from Kanji.
Oh, is that so?

Yutaro Katori is my name!
Pilot of Fighbird am I!

Well met!
Brother Kanji!

Uh, y-yeah...
nice to meet you...

Big Bro Katori's really into
samurai dramas right now.

Oh... I see.
Ha ha... You surprised me there
for a second.
I'm Kenta Amano.

I ride the Fire Jet
with Big Bro Katori.

Huh?
You ride in it too?
Heh heh!

And this here is
my granddaughter...
I'm Haruka Amano.

I'm in charge of this
household's finances.
Pleased to meet you!

Oh!
Please thank Captain Rie for me
about the electric bill.

Hm?
Is that the kind of deal
you've worked out?

Yes. Before you came, Kanji, I talked
all sorts of things over with her
on the phone.

Wow...
You're really on top of things.

Ain't she?
She's a granddaughter I can
rely on.
Seems like it.

But... you run a machine like that
with just this handful of staff?
That's right.

To begin with, we don't have
any spare money to hire folks.

But you've been protecting
this city, right?

My lab runs on the goodwill
of people who want peace.

Protecting this city is just how
it turned out. That's all.
I see.
Well then, look after us.

Joined up with the main staff of the
Amano Peace Science Laboratory.
Fighbird has been deployed.

rows.notes: [17]-[18] Katori's period-drama speech (see [20] and his library profile) rendered with archaic flavor; [jp] -> 'Brother Kanji'. [jp] -> 'Big Bro Katori'. [20] [jp] -> 'samurai dramas'. [24] [jp] read as 'you ride in it too'. Dr. Amano's dialect ([jp]/[jp]) given a folksy tone.

segments.en: Big Bro!
What?

Sorry, you just got back!
More new staff are joining.
Could you go to "Sankai High School"?
Yeah, sure, but...

Is it really okay to poach
this many people?
I am a little worried...
Hey, hey!

Just kidding!
That's not how it is.

Everyone said they couldn't just look
the other way... so they're
helping us out.

Besides, having people from
each region join us

means more people will understand
what we're doing, right?
Well, sure, but...

Oh, sorry,
Big Bro.

I've still got
work to do.

Ah, right.
Sorry for holding you up.

Well, I'm off.
"Sankai High School," right?

Yep!
I'm counting on you!
Roger.

rows.notes: [9]-[10] one sentence split across two pages in the source; cut at the matching point. | [editorial 16] 'Thanks a lot!' can read sarcastic; [jp] is Rie's request (accuracy flag)

segments.en: Sankai High School

We've been expecting you.
I'm Kai, head of the
disciplinary committee.

Hearing that we may accompany the
fleet, I am filled with a solemn
sense of duty.

At last, the time to strike back
has come. I will work myself
to the bone!

For the sake of world peace,
let us fight together!
Yeah!
Man, this is way too stiff.

Not for me, man.
A battleship? Ugh.
You think so?

It's like the pinnacle of science.
I'm kind of interested.

You idiots!!
Think about how great a mission
the people are asking of us!

Ow ow ow ow!!
Why only me?!
Ahem...!

Pardon me. I expect my fellow
students will cause you a great deal
of trouble, but...

I will keep them in line myself,
so I must ask your forbearance.

Ha ha... There's no need
to be so stiff.

No!
In all things, the beginning
is what matters most.

Leave discipline aboard ship
to me!

Uh, r-right...
I'm counting on you, then.

Joined up with the members
of Dagwon.

rows.notes: [4] speaker header Rai Utsumi (glossary short name Rai). [11] En complains he alone got punished (Kai presumably hits/grabs him). [13] [jp] -> 'my fellow students' (Kai is a student, not a teacher).

segments.en:
This is Capital City.
It's a neutral zone, so we can dock.

GAIL and several other companies
have come to sell their goods.

Looks like we can resupply
here too...

There was a place like this
on the Brave Continent?

Means they struck a good deal
with the enemy.

From what I've found, this city is
home to the headquarters of a giant
corporation called "GAIL."

Apparently they sell weapons
across continents...

So basically, it's a supply
point for the enemy, too.

It seems they have branches all
across the Earth Realm.

They appear to have more than
a few ties to the Redros Army, too.

rows.notes: [jp] -> GAIL, as in the library machine entries ([jp]). [jp] Capital City (not in the glossary).

segments.en: Emergency transmission!

Enemies are massing at
Capital City!!

Looks like they still
want to fight.

They don't even care that
it's a neutral zone...!

This is the final push to
liberate the Brave Continent!

All forces, launch for
Capital City!!
Enemy forces detected.
Commencing battle!
Enemy forces repelled!

Capital City
is liberated!

rows.notes: Swan's [jp] accent not reproduced (also row 39).

segments.en: Oh, Rie.

There's a man named Rod
from GAIL here to see you.

I see...
Then please show him to the lounge.
Roger!
First off, I owe you my thanks.
Huh?

Thanks to you chasing off the Redros and
Deloyer armies, GAIL's top brass is in
an uproar.

Now that those sly old badgers have proven
useless, my word carries more weight.
That's the long and short of it.

I see.
So, what did you want to discuss?

From now on, as far as my authority allows,
GAIL promises to provide your forces with
supplies and information.

A bit late for that!
Weren't you helping the Redros Army
all this time?

The winds have changed.
We need your strength, that's all.

Besides, GAIL's a business. When an army
demands goods, we can't exactly refuse to
sell, can we?
I understand that...

But people don't have a good impression
of your company. Not at all.

That stings...
Well, trading's a free choice.
I won't force you.

But I'm headed to Austral after this.
This is your only chance.
To Austral?

Austral lies at the edge of the Astragius
Continent. It's inside Balarant's sphere
of influence.

Unless you're willing to cross swords with
Balarant, there's no getting in.
So what about it?
There's a gate on Austral...

Most likely a gate that leads to
the Redros Army's home base.
What?!

Even I don't know what's on the other side.
Believe it or not, that's up to you.

But with GAIL as go-between, you could
enter Balarant territory too.
That alone isn't a bad deal, is it?
That's true, but...

Don't get the wrong idea.
I couldn't care less about the
company's reputation.

I don't want to sell weapons like my
old man. I just want to expose those
guys' schemes.

And to do that...
I need to team up with you.
Understood.
Please lend us your strength.

It goes both ways.
Well then, I'm counting on you.

Gained the cooperation of
GAIL's Rod faction.
Rod has joined the unit.

rows.notes: Seg 7: [jp] rendered 'sly old badgers' (GAIL's old executives). Seg 21-22: [jp] kept lowercase 'gate' (Rod is describing one; capitalised elsewhere for the dimensional Gates -- reviewer may unify). Seg 30: [jp] = 'my old man' (Rod's relation per library is grandson of chairman Roy; kept the source's word). Seg 22 'those guys' = [jp], referent unstated (Redros side presumably). | [editorial 23] [jp]: 'What did you say?' read as not hearing; matches other 'What!?' renderings | [editorial 31] 'join hands' stiff for Rod's casual voice

segments.en:
With this, the enemy can no longer
mount organized resistance on the
Brave Continent.

Now it's time for us in the Brave
Alliance to help you.

All right!
Let's head out for a new continent!

rows.notes: [jp] = 'Brave Alliance' (not in glossary; check slice _00's rendering). | [editorial 1] 'Now it's our turn, the Brave Alliance, to help you' awkward apposition

segments.en: We have entered the Brave Continent.

Picked up a guidance signal from
Capital City! Displaying marker!

Your Excellency, preparations to conclude
alliances with the various factions
are complete.

For the time being, please stop by
Capital City.
Very well.

rows.notes: Seg 1: [jp] read as typo for [jp].

segments.en:
Multinational conglomerate
GAIL Headquarters Building

His Excellency won't be taking part
in the negotiations?

These alliance talks are being held far
and wide across the Earth Realm. As such,
there are plenty of small fry.

There's no need for His Excellency
to deal with the likes of them.

It also serves to make them understand
where they really stand.

We've made contact with the Deloyer
8th Army, which is invading Brave.

From now on, they can take part in
operations on the Brave Continent.

With this, it is now possible to seize
each of the strongholds.

Please seize all strongholds on the
Brave Continent without delay.
Good!

When to launch the operation,
I leave to the front-line units.
I'm counting on you, Omega, Kanji!
Roger.
Understood, sir!

Okay then...
Time to set up the squads!

Lieutenant Kanji, please wait.
Commander Rochina is asking for you.

Huh?
Me?

It's a meeting about the operation's
strategy.

I believe it would be best to attend
before setting up your squads.
Oh, right.

Lord Omega has already gone.
Please hurry as well, Lieutenant Kanji.
Okay, okay.

(Something's different from usual...
 this atmosphere...)

(Well, maybe it's the Astante's atmosphere
 that's the weird one.)
Is something the matter?
No, it's nothing.

Most of the Brave Continent is held by
the Deloyer 8th Army -- in other words,
by friendly forces.

Therefore, the chance of contact with
the enemy while under way is low.

However, a troublesome enemy still holds
the areas around the major cities.
Troublesome enemy?

Each city has an independent so-called
defense organization, but their forces
themselves are nothing much.

However, the few powerful machines each
of those organizations operates are
hampering the invasion.

According to our investigation, the
8th Army's advance has stalled these
past few months.
Just a few machines did that...?

Initially, they apparently planned the
invasion with the Deloyer 8th Army alone,

but lately they reportedly can't even
hold the front without reinforcements
from the Gilgamesh regular army.

Which is exactly why there's value
in our intervening.

Deloyer is nothing more than
a province of Gilgamesh.

An expedition across continents...
This operation was overreaching
from the start.

Gilgamesh's top brass merely jumped on
Deloyer's bid to score points.

Heh...!
Strange words, coming from a man
born in Gilgamesh...

To me, the future of Gilgamesh is
of no great importance.

Listen. Conquering Brave will put
Gilgamesh deeply in our debt.

I want you both to recognize anew
how important this operation is.

Understood.
Let's work out the best plan.
Agreed.
Then I'm counting on you.

Lieutenant Kanji!
Please wait!
Is there something else?

The power of the large machines that form
the core of the enemy forces defending
the cities is greater than you imagine.

But if you can just deal with those,
the rest are small fry.
I see.
And one more thing.

We've received reports of a powerful
special forces unit among the enemy's
infantry as well.

Our investigation of them hasn't
progressed, so their strength is
an unknown quantity.

Got it.
I'll beef up the Infantry Squad too.
Thanks for going to the trouble.

Forgive me, but I thought you might
not read the reports very closely.
Gulp!
How'd you know?
Please don't let it trouble you.

I hear many pilots suited to real combat
are like that.

I believe people like you, Lieutenant Kanji,
are also needed in the military.

Let me see...
I'd say you have qualities
Lord Omega lacks.

Oh, right.
You're Omega's personal secretary,
aren't you?

I ask that you continue to support
Lord Omega, as always.
Yeah, I'll give it everything I've got!

rows.notes: Aria's [jp] -> 'Captain Kanji' (Kanji is [jp] on the Redros route; 'Lord Omega' kept as in earlier slices). Seg 2-4: speaker header is Rochina answering Omega; seg 5 onward is a new beat (Rochina reporting to Redros). Seg 7: Aria's line acts as the system/operator voice. Seg 45 [jp] read as Omega and Kanji ('you both'). Seg 59: [jp] object unstated; supplied 'the reports' (the briefing material) from context. | [editorial 33] [jp] 'survey' unidiomatic here

segments.en: Launching the operation.

Wipe out the enemy forces defending
the key strongholds of the Brave
Continent.
We are approaching the outskirts of Tokio.
Enemy forces sighted!

Good!
All units, charge in!

rows.notes: [jp] = 'Tokio' (GaoGaiGar city spelling, not in glossary). [jp] read as [jp].

segments.en:
It seems the enemy is keeping its regular
forces in the rear while sending GGG's
ships to the front.
Mm...

Units of the Deloyer 8th Army
have arrived!

I suppose they can't stand the thought of
us stealing their glory.

That army's failed to take this city all
this time. They're not to be relied on.

So they've come...
That's the Redros Army
we've heard about.
Ready, Guy?!

Yeah!!
I'm good to go anytime!!
All right!
Final Fusion!
Activation approved!!
Program... drive!!

There it is!!
It's GaoFighGar!!
As I thought...

Their tactics are precarious...
They rely entirely on the strength
of a few.

We'll take them in one fell swoop!
Commence attack!!

rows.notes: [accuracy 10] [jp] dropped: Taiga approves the activation of Final Fusion

segments.en:
Damn!
I didn't think the Redros Army
would be this strong!
I-It's hopeless...!
Don't give up!
GGG hasn't been taken yet!
You're right.

All GGG staff, abandon headquarters
and withdraw!
Everyone, hurry!!
We've secured air superiority.

All that's left is to seize GGG
headquarters with the Infantry Squad.
Good!
Now, what's our next move?

Choose whether to go straight
into infantry combat.

Attack now
Prepare first

The outcome is already decided.
Send in the Infantry Squad!!
We're still short on strength.

Keep the city surrounded!
Hold off on the infantry assault
for now!

rows.notes: Seg 5 is a two-option choice page.

segments.en:
Enemy infantry has broken
into GGG!!
Here they come...!
Let's go, Guy!
Right!!

This is GGG's own operation.
We can't get support from anyone else.

In this situation, we're better off
without it.

Listen, all you have to do is buy time
for the staff to escape.
I know, Commander.
I'm counting on you!
So you've shown up, small fry!
Here I come!!

Hm?
You're...!!

Heh! Guy!
We're here to back you up!!
Guy! Renais!!

There's no way you two can
handle this alone!!
The city has already surrendered.

This fight is GGG's own fight.
We can't accept your help!

Huh?
What's that supposed to mean?

Anyway, you need to get away
from here.

Then we'll join GGG right now.
That makes it okay, right?
Hey, hey...

Heh!
Why not?
I doubt these kids would slow us down.
True enough...

All right then,
I'm counting on you!
Yeah!!
Toya, it looks like it's settled.
Yeah!
So the stage is all set, huh?
Then let me at 'em!

If we all work together, none of us
will have to push ourselves too hard.
Now, let us go!
You lot are as roundabout as ever.
I'm doing things my way from here on!

rows.notes: Seg 26: [jp] read as typo for [jp]. Seg 7 'You're...' -- Guy recognises Toya (who answers next). | [accuracy 18] hedge [jp] restored (Renais's guess, not a certainty) | [editorial 28] verb restored (accuracy flag); 'Roundabout as ever, you lot' fragmentary

segments.en:
We won the battle, but most of GGG's
members got away.

Hmph...
So they intend a rematch.

Well, no matter. It doesn't change the
fact that Tokio has fallen.
Tokio has been conquered.
Proceed to the next target.

We are approaching the outskirts of
Nouvelle Tokio.
Enemy forces sighted!

Good!
All units, charge in!

rows.notes: [jp] = 'Nouvelle Tokio' (Might Gaine city, not in glossary).

segments.en:
Master Maito!
Enemy forces have reached the
second defense line!!
Right! It's our turn!

Let's go!
Might Gaine!

Carrying hope on silver wings,
light up the green signal of peace!

Brave Express Might Gaine,
arriving right on schedule!

Now feel it in your own flesh -- payback
for all the suffering you've caused!
I'll settle this in one go!

Damn that Redros Army...
If those guys win,
we'll be out of business.

But what do we do?
The operation's already started!

The "Fang of the Sun."
If we nab them ourselves,
there's money in it.

And on top of that, the Redros Army
will owe us one.

If we get on their good side,
we can stay in business.

But this is the Brave Continent.
The "Fang of the Sun" on this front?

They're here!
I guarantee it!!

Here they come!!
Deploy the units!!

No!
Mr. Locke!
You're too far ahead!

Leave the front-line fighting
to Might Gaine!

This enemy won't be like the ones before.
We have to give it our all too!
But...!

Don't worry,
I have a plan of sorts.

Crinn!
Are you ready!!

Yes!
Dougram, moving out!!

See!
Just like I figured.

Whoa!
It's the Dougram!!
The "Fang of the Sun," here of all places...!

Listen, don't let anyone
beat you to them!!
Right!

For the sake of this city,
which took us in...
...we can't back down here!

Everyone!
This isn't the final battle.
Make sure you survive!
Maito's right.
Let's each do our best!

As expected, Might Gaine
has come out.
Mm...

But aren't the units deployed around it
Deloyer weapons?

Yes, that is the
"Deloyer Liberation Front."

Most likely people who escaped from
the state of Deloyer...

Looks like some confusing guys
just showed up.
The Deloyer Liberation Front, huh...
Pretty bold for a bunch of guerrillas.
That suits me fine.

Looks like we won't have to fight
in the streets.

They're only guests here. They can't go
as far as turning the city to ash.

Lord Omega!
Sortie orders!
Understood.

Let's go!
Kanji!!
Right!!

rows.notes: Izumi's [jp] -> 'Master Maito' (and [jp] in row 58 -> 'Mr. Maito'). Seg 3-4 Might Gaine arrival call and seg 5 Maito's line translated for meaning (no glossary form). Seg 15 [jp] -> 'Mr. Locke'. [jp] -> 'Deloyer Liberation Front' (library uses 'Deloyer Liberation Army' for J. Locke's affiliation; the source here says [jp] -- reviewer may unify). Garcia's gender unknown: no pronouns used. Seg 36 [jp]: they look like Deloyer (allied) forces but are enemies -- 'confusing'. | [accuracy 1] verb restored ([jp] = it's our turn)

segments.en:
Ngh...!
What is with these guys?!

We can still fight!
Don't give up!

Yeah!
The fight's only just begun!

Wait!
This is the time to pull back.
We can still fight!

Pushing ourselves now won't win us
a complete victory.

Don't worry. I planned for this.
Our withdrawal is already arranged.
But what about everyone at HQ?!

It's fine, Maito.
HQ is all packed up and ready to move.

Mr. Maito!
Please fall back!

But...
abandoning Nouvelle Tokio...

No!
I can't do it!
Think calmly, Maito.

If we keep fighting,
the city will be damaged...

But if we pull back, the city will
be spared any fatal harm.
Will it really...?

I hear the Redros Army places great
weight on military discipline. They're
unlikely to loot without reason.

They should have gotten the message that
we're willing to fight. That's enough
for now.
Understood.
Maito, let's fall back!
Roger...

All right!
All forces, withdraw!!

rows.notes: Seg 14: source [jp] is garbled ('fatal unharmed'); rendered as 'spared any fatal harm' (likely intent: [jp]).

segments.en:
The mayor has declared surrender.
We can dock there as well.
Good. Well done, everyone!

We'll prepare for the next operation.
Once resupplied, we head for the
next target.

rows.notes: [editorial 0] [jp] = 'dock' (project decision; UI 'Dock') | [editorial 2] 'We prepare for the next operation' unnatural as Redros's order

segments.en:
Hey!
You there, youngster.

Mind putting me through to your
fleet commander?

Oh, sure.
Got it.

His Excellency Redros, the fleet's
supreme commander, is busy.
I'll hear what you have to say instead.

Heh!
Commander Rochina, huh...
You sure wormed your way in nicely.

I merely let myself be carried
by the tide of history.

And what about you?
Will you remain Lecoque's pawn?

Hmph!
Never had any intention of that
to begin with.

I've got no principles or causes.
Money's everything in this world.

So long as you pay what's owed,
I'll do anything.

Very well.
We'll decide what to do with you.
Then we have a deal.

Let's keep our business smart,
both of us.

The Garcia Squad has come under
your command.

Machines added:
Tequila Gunner
Soltic
We are approaching Kyoto.
Enemy forces sighted!!

Good!
All units, charge in!

rows.notes: [jp] (katakana in source) -> 'Kyoto'.

segments.en:
A troublesome one's shown up
on our flank...

A lone unit that rushed in
won't hold out for long.

Keep our distance and let it
burn through its energy.

Lord Omega!
Sortie orders!

Let's go!
Kanji!!
Right!!

rows.notes: Seg 0-2: the flanking lone unit is unnamed here (GaoGaiGar per row 63).

segments.en:
No way...
GaoGaiGar lost...

It's galling... but we can't keep
fighting here any longer.
Big Bro Guy...

This is GGG
Kyoto Branch~!

Withdrawal preparations
are complete~!

I won't give up. I'll take back
the Brave Continent, no matter what!

You'll come with me, won't you?
Mamoru!
Yeah!!
All right! Let's move out!!

rows.notes: Mamoru's [jp] -> 'Big Bro Guy' (cf. Rie's 'Big Bro'). Swan's [jp] accent shown only with '~'.

segments.en:
The mayor of Tokio has declared
surrender.
We can now dock at Tokio.
Good. Well done, everyone!

We'll prepare for the next operation.
Once resupplied, we head for the
next target.

rows.notes: Source says [jp] although this follows the Kyoto battle (rows 61-63); likely a source slip -- kept 'Tokio' as written. | [editorial 1] [jp] = 'dock' (project decision) | [editorial 3] 'We prepare for...' unnatural; same line as row 59

segments.en: We are approaching Yosho Town.
Enemy forces sighted!!

Good!
All units, charge in!

rows.notes: [jp] -> 'Yosho Town' (matches 'Yosho Academy' in the library).

segments.en: We adults need to get it together!

Don't fall behind Raijin-Oh! Show them
what the Defense Force is made of!!
Everyone, are you ready?
Radar, no problems.
Totally OK!
Combining functions, no problems.
All systems appear to be fine.

The enemy's right in front of us!
We're combining Raijin-Oh.

Jin, sorry to keep you waiting!
The command room is up and running!
Ready to combine!

Yeah!
Let's do this!!
Koji, Asuka, let's combine!
Roger!
All riiight, let's do it!!

Raijin-Oh!
Invincible Combination!

Absolutely Invincible!
Raaaijin-Ohhh!!
Let's go! Kanji!!
Roger!!

rows.notes: Commander Takeda's gender unknown; no pronouns. Raijin-Oh combination call translated for meaning (no glossary form). Seg 4 [jp]: playful [jp]. | [proofread 12] style sheet 'All right' (not 'Alright'); stretched vowel kept

segments.en:
Dammit!
Those guys are strong!!

Jin!
The Defense Force is withdrawing!
Raijin-Oh, follow us!!

What!
You're saying we run away?!

Just fighting blindly won't cut it!
They aren't like the Evil Beasts!
Jin, we can't fight anymore.
Daaamn it!!

rows.notes: [jp] -> 'Evil Beasts' (Raijin-Oh's monsters; not in glossary).

segments.en: Yosho Town has declared surrender.
We can now dock at Yosho Town.
Well done, everyone!

We'll prepare for the next operation.
Once resupplied, we head for the
next target.

rows.notes: [editorial 1] [jp] = 'dock' (project decision) | [editorial 3] 'We prepare for...' unnatural; same line as row 59

segments.en: We are approaching Aozora Town.
Enemy forces sighted!!

Good!
All units, charge in!

rows.notes: [jp] -> 'Aozora Town' (library: Aozora Elementary School).

segments.en: We adults need to get it together!

Don't fall behind Gambaruger! Show them
what the Defense Force is made of!!

By Colonel von Stein's orders, I have
come to support your forces.

Just what I'd expect of Major Zaltsev.
Right on time.

And your deployment is exactly as
we arranged beforehand.
Naturally, sir!

I now hand command of my unit
over to you.
You're sure about this?
This operation will succeed!

It's precisely because I'm sure of it
that I entrust command to you.

Then I must also do my utmost to draw
out your abilities to the fullest.
Thank you, sir!
Come and get us if you dare!
We're not scared of any enemy!

Blue Ganbar,
giving it my all!!

All right, here we go!
Gambaruger, Miracle Combination!!

Bursting with energy!
Gambaruger!!
Let's go! Kanji!!
Roger!!

rows.notes: [jp] -> 'Colonel von Stein' (glossary [jp] Von Stein; 8th Army commander). Zaltsev's gender unknown: no pronouns. Seg 14 [jp] puns on Ganbar. Gambaruger calls translated for meaning. | [editorial 9] 'convinced of that that' clumsy

segments.en:
Dammit!
Those guys are strong!!

Jin!
The Defense Force is withdrawing!
Raijin-Oh, follow us!!

What!
You're saying we run away?!

Just fighting blindly won't cut it!
They aren't like the Evil Beasts!
Jin, we can't fight anymore.
Daaamn it!!

rows.notes: [jp] -> 'Evil Beasts' (Raijin-Oh's monsters; not in glossary).

segments.en:
If you'll allow it, I would like
permission to stay on with your forces.

I don't mind, but you'll be leaving
the 8th Army.

I've already received permission from
Colonel von Stein.

You work fast.
Very well, permission granted.
Sir!
The Zaltsev Squad has joined the unit.

Machines added:
Soltic, Crab Gunner
Instead, Duey

Supreme Commander Redros,
Aozora Town has just declared
surrender.
We can dock immediately.

We'll prepare for the next operation.
Once resupplied, we head for the
next target.

rows.notes: [editorial 8] [jp] = 'dock' (project decision) | [editorial 9] 'We prepare for...' unnatural; same line as row 59 | [proofread 6] system-message format: names without quotes, as 'Machines added:' in row 60 k15

segments.en: We are approaching Sankai City.

There are reports of an infantry unit in
this city that specializes in surprise
attacks.

The Deloyer 8th Army also came under
their surprise attacks and was forced
to withdraw.
We must not underestimate them.

Are you saying they'll board us right
through the fleet's tight security?

Yes, sir!
There appear to have been actual
cases of it.

So our only option is to counter them
with an "Infantry Squad."
Is your "Infantry Squad" ready?

It's ready
Not ready yet

Our "Infantry Squad" is at full
strength.

We should have no trouble attacking
as we are.

No sense rushing.
We'll come back another time.
Then we'll change course.

rows.notes: Seg 8 is a two-option choice page. [jp] -> 'Sankai City' (library: Sankai High School). | [accuracy 12] subject: Rochina relays the fleet's course change, not his own

segments.en: The enemy's come callin'!
Big Bro Katori!!

All right!
Here we go!!

As long as Fighbird is here, I won't let
anyone disturb the peace of the universe!
Looks like I made it in time.
Maito!!

Well I'll be!
You rushed all the way here
from Nouvelle Tokio?

If the Amano Lab is in danger, I'll come
running anytime. I'm one of its investors,
after all!

Bwahahah!!
Well, ain't you somethin'!

Katori!
Let me lend you a hand!

You got it!
Let's do this together,
Maito!
So that's Fighbird.

And Might Gaine as well...
That's somewhat unexpected.

They must have caught wind of our army's
movements... Their intelligence network
is not to be underestimated either.
Yes, sir...

Unidentified unit detected!
Extremely close!!
What!!

Redros Army!
I'm warning you!

Might Gaine is my prey.
Keep your hands off!
That, I cannot promise.

Then I'll shoot anyone who comes near
me, without mercy!
Keep that in mind.

Understood,
Ace Joe.

Heh...
Then that's what I'll do!

There you are!
Might Gaine!!
Ace Joe!!
Maito Senpuuji!

Now's the time
I settle things with you!

Stop it!
I'm fighting the Redros Army!

Butt out!
I ain't got time to play with you!
What!!

This is a fight to see justice through
to the end!
Stand back!

Hmph!
This thing called justice
is worthless!

The strong win.
That's all there is to it!!

Here I come!
Maito Senpuuji!!
Ngh!!

Tch!
This guy won't listen
to reason!
Let's go! Kanji!!
Roger!!

rows.notes: Joe's [jp] (typo for [jp]) -> 'Maito Senpuuji'. Joe Rival's gender is blank in speakers.tsv: no pronouns used. Kenta's [jp] -> 'Big Bro Katori'. Katori's rough jidaigeki-style lines (seg 29, 36) kept rough. Seg 3 Fighbird intro translated for meaning (no glossary form). Seg 12-13: Redros (seg 11/13) and Rochina (seg 12/14) per headers. | [editorial 7] 'I am an investor' read as stressed/stiff; natural phrasing of [jp] | [editorial 20] passive 'will be shot' replaced: Joe is the one shooting ([jp]...[jp]), punchier threat | [editorial 32] 'There's no value in something called justice' was stilted; keeps the dismissive [jp]

segments.en:
Dang it!
Is this the end...?!

The Redros Army...
What a fearsome foe...

We can't lose!
Are we just gonna leave them be?!

Easy, Katori!
We've still got a card to play!

Huh?
Grandpa, you've still
got something?
Mm... somethin' like that.
For now, we skedaddle!
Whaaat?!
You got it!

Wha--!
Wait!!

Are we just going to let them
do as they please?

That's why!
For now, we live to fight another day!
But...!

Leave for now!
Maito Senpuuji.

However lucky you may be,
there's nothing you can do
in this situation.

I'll settle our score
someday.

I won't allow you to die
a pointless death here!
Ngh...!

Gaine!
We're pulling out!!
Roger!

rows.notes: Seg 13: [jp] typo -> Maito Senpuuji. Seg 8 [jp] (Katori's period-drama speech) -> 'You got it!'. | [proofread 9] dash style '--' for the cut-off word (corpus form 'Wha--!')

segments.en:
Hm!
What's going on?!

Enemy soldiers have infiltrated
the ship!!
I see, so that's their game.

But we've already prepared for this.
Have the Infantry Squad wipe them out!

Enemy soldiers have infiltrated
the ship!!

Enemy soldiers heading
for Block E02!

Infantry Squad, proceed to the
scene at once!

Huh?
Where's Block E02...?
They're coming here!
Dagwon has arrived!!

Getting in was easier
than I thought.
Yeah.

But now that we're aboard...
are we sure this is the right ship?

Yes!
This is the enemy flagship!

If this goes well, we could even
turn the tables!
Now that's awesome!

Don't get ahead of yourselves! Our goal is
to buy time for the Amano Lab to get
clear to safety.

Is this any time to fret over
the little things?!

All we gotta do is smash
everything to bits!!
Hell yeah!!
Well, all right! Let's do it!

Blast it!
You bunch of idiots!

Wait.
The enemy is here.

Be careful.
They're not like anyone we've faced.

Heh!
This'll be fun!
Bring it on!

rows.notes: Geki's dialect ([jp]/[jp]) rendered as rough speech. [jp] -> 'the Amano Lab'. | [editorial 9] 'We just smash everything' read as a statement; Geki's rough 'that's all it takes' ([jp])

segments.en: To think they're this skilled...
We can't hold out much longer...

Good news!
Looks like the Amano Lab has finished
relocating its facilities!

Right!
We're pulling out!

Hold on! Hey!
We can still fight!!

Damn right!
Now's the time to show 'em
our Dagwon spirit!

Our objective is already achieved.
Don't waste your strength.

Even getting off this ship
is going to be tough, you know.

Do you really have enough strength
left for that?

Argh, fine!
I get it already!

rows.notes: [accuracy 2] hedge [jp] restored

segments.en:
Supreme Commander Redros,
Aozora Town has just announced
its surrender.
We can dock immediately.

We'll prepare for the next operation.
Once resupplied, we head for the
next target.

rows.notes: Source names [jp] although this follows the Sankai City battle (rows 73-78); identical wording to row 72's ending, likely a source slip -- kept 'Aozora Town' as written. | [editorial 0] 'declared surrender' unidiomatic | [editorial 1] project term: [jp] = 'dock' | [proofread 2] same line as dlg_4822_10363_01 rows 59/64/68/72, which editorial changed from 'We prepare'; brought into line

segments.en:
Reporting!
The Deloyer 8th Army reports it has
finished securing its assigned sector.

Your Excellency, with this the conquest
of the Brave Continent is complete,
for the time being.

The Brave Alliance...
A rabble, but I'd say they put up
a good fight.

And no small number of their forces
seem to have slipped through our net.
We are pursuing them as we speak.

But the enemy's main force is no longer
on this continent...

Perhaps they're lying low in
another world?

I think so as well. Most likely the
surviving units of the Claudian Unified
Forces are involved...
Something like that, I'd wager.
Well, that is also what I'm after.
So it is.

Even left alone, the times move on.
We shall press forward!

We head for the next continent!
All hands, begin preparations!

rows.notes: Seg 9: [jp] -- Redros's aim left unexplained, as in the source. | [accuracy 0] hearsay [jp] restored (the soldier is relaying the 8th Army's word)
